title: Bank Loan Data Analysis Report
description: The Advanced Loan Data Analysis Dashboard is designed to provide deep insights into lending operations, borrower behavior, and financial performance. By leveraging Power BI, DAX calculations, and interactive visualizations, it helps financial analysts and decision-makers optimize loan strategies.

title: Power Bi Sales Report
description: This project presents an interactive Sales Dashboard built with Power BI to analyze sales performance across countries (Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany) over the years 2014 to 2017.

title: Mo Salah Premier League Matches Analysis
description: This project focuses on analyzing the performance of Mohamed Salah in the English Premier League. It aims to extract insights from his match history such as goals, assists, appearances, and overall contribution per season.

title: Diamond Price Analysis and Forecasting
description: This project focuses on analyzing diamond prices based on their characteristics (carat, cut, color, clarity, etc.) and building a predictive model to estimate diamond prices.

title: Forecasting Website Traffic Case Study
description: This project develops a time series forecasting model to predict website traffic for TheCleverProgrammer.com. The analysis covers visitor data from June 2021 to June 2022, with the goal of understanding traffic patterns and building accurate predictions for future periods.

title: Craigslist Used Vehicles Dataset Analysis
description: This project analyzes a vehicle listing dataset, focusing on various factors such as price, condition, fuel type, transmission, and location. It includes visualizing the distribution of vehicles by year and country and providing insights into market trends.

title: US Health Insurance EDA
description: Medical Insurance is a contract that requires an insurer to pay some or all of a person's healthcare costs in exchange for a premium, with the insurance typicallly pays for medical expenses incured by the insured. Insurance cost differs from each individual, certain variable may affect a person insurance cost to be higher or lower. This project will analyze medical insurance cost in a dataset and exploring variables that may affect it. Further, this project will showcase data analysis skills to provide meaningful insight.

title: Reddit Daily Public Opinions Analysis on the Palestinian-Israel 7th Oct War
description: The objective of this project is to analyze Reddit comments related to the Israel-Palestine conflict using sentiment analysis techniques to understand public opinion trends. The dataset includes columns such as comment text, subreddit, timestamp, sentiment score, and sentiment label. Using Python, I processed the comments to extract sentiment insights, identify popular discussion times, and categorize comments based on their emotional tone (positive, negative, neutral). The analysis also explored the most active subreddits and controversial discussions, providing a comprehensive view of online sentiment around this issue.

title: Auto MPG Dataset Analysis
description: The MPG dataset is technical specifications of cars originally provided from UCI Machine Learning Repository and can be found on Kaggle here. The data concerns city-cycle fuel consumption in miles per gallon to be analyzed in terms of 3 multivalued discrete and 5 continuous attributes.

title: Restoring Maji Ndogo's Water Access - ExploreAI Academy Data science Program project
description: This section explores the water crisis in Maji Ndogo through SQL analysis, focusing on database exploration, schema overview, query samples, project-related questions, and instructions for use.

title: TMDB Movie Database - ExploreAI Academy Data science Program project
description: This project centers around a movie database containing comprehensive information about movies, including details such as titles, release dates, actors, genres, awards, and more.

title: Calidon Report - Meem Ain for educational consulting
description: Using Power BI, Power Query, and Excel, this report links the results of a survey given to children aged 7 to 10 years to the results of their playing the Calidon game, which measures children’s interaction in different situations to measure 8 basic skills for children.

title: US Bike-share - Udacity data analyst graduation project
description: Using Python, analyze US bike-share data, compute descriptive statistics to address dataset questions. Create a script for terminal interaction, offering a user-friendly, interactive stats presentation.

title: Investigate a Dataset - Udacity data analyst graduation project
description: Analyzing a TMDb dataset of 10,000 movies with Jupyter Notebook & Python, specifically investigating user ratings and revenue patterns via statistical techniques for comprehensive insights.

title: Diabetes Prediction Model using Regression - MeriSKILL Internship
description: This project aims to develop a predictive model to determine whether a patient has diabetes based on certain diagnostic measurements. The dataset used for this analysis is originally from the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. The objective is to diagnostically predict whether a patient has diabetes using various medical predictor variables.

title: HR Employee Attrition Report - MeriSKILL Internship
description: A demographic report summarizes employee statistics, including age groups, gender, distance from home, and marital status, providing insights into workforce diversity and commuting patterns for informed decision-making.

title: Sales Report Dashboard - MeriSKILL Internship
description: The report aims to analyze sales data to extract valuable insights for business decision-making. It includes various visuals such as Sales By Month, Sales By Orders, Top 5 Cities by Sales, Top 5 Selling Products by Quantity, Weekly Sales Distribution, and Top 5 Products by Sales Count. Additionally, it provides slicers for filtering data by City, Product, Month, and Day name. Key metrics such as Revenue, Sales Margin, and Sales Quantity are also highlighted. The data was cleaned using Power Query, and advanced techniques like DAX language and toggle buttons were employed for data manipulation and visualization, showcasing proficiency in handling large datasets and making data-driven recommendations for optimizing sales strategies.

title: Alibaba SQL Project - placementdost Internship
description: The objective of this project is to analyze an Alibaba dataset using SQL to extract meaningful insights related to product sales, pricing trends, and customer preferences. The dataset includes columns such as S_no, Name, Category, Cost_Price, Item_Price, Special_Price, Quantity, Payment_Method, and Shipping_City.

title: Restaurant orders - PlacementDost Internship
description: The project aimed to develop a comprehensive restaurant management system using MS SQL. The dataset provided consisted of menu details and order details, which were utilized to create and populate tables within the SQL database. Various SQL queries and operations were performed to retrieve, analyze, modify, and manage restaurant data effectively.

title: HR Employee Survey Responses - PlacementDost Internship
description: The project aimed to analyze employee survey data using Microsoft Excel. The dataset included responses from employees across different departments, with varying levels of agreement/disagreement on several statements. The goal was to import, clean, analyze, and visualize the data to derive meaningful insights regarding employee satisfaction and areas for improvement within the organization.

title: Airlines loyalty - PlacementDost Internship
description: This project involved analyzing data related to customer behavior, flight activity, loyalty history, and calendar events for PlacementDost Internship using Power BI and MS Excel. The objective was to derive actionable insights to optimize customer engagement, loyalty programs, and revenue generation.

title: Hotel Reservation Analysis - Mentorness Internship
description: In this project, the goal was to analyze a hotel reservation dataset using SQL to gain insights into guest preferences, booking trends, and other key factors affecting the hotel's operations. The dataset contained various columns such as Booking_ID, no_of_adults, no_of_children, type_of_meal_plan, room_type_reserved, lead_time, arrival_date, market_segment_type, avg_price_per_room, and booking_status.

title: Employees Dashboard - Personal Project
description: Built as a dashboard using Power BI and Power Query, it utilizes employee data from an Excel sheet to offer insights on salaries, ratings, and gender distribution, enabling streamlined analysis of employee-related metrics.

title: Sales Report Dashboard - Personal Project
description: This Power BI dashboard, powered by data from Excel sales reports, showcases monthly and daily selling values, total sales, and profits. Offering an intuitive interface, it enables users to effortlessly analyze and glean insights into sales performance.

title: Al-Omar for Import and Export 2016-2018 Dashboard
description: Creating an Al-Omar for Import and Export 2016-2018 Dashboard via Power BI and Power Query, using data from the company's datasheet. Offers key insights into company performance, showcasing exporting country count, remaining and paid amounts, and detailed export country breakdowns.

title: AdventureWorks SQL Business Analysis Project
description: A complete SQL business analysis answering 15 decision-focused questions across sales, customers, products, inventory, and geographic performance.
challenge: Turn a large relational business database into clear answers for commercial and operational stakeholders.
approach: Designed structured SQL queries around revenue, customer behavior, product performance, inventory, and geography, with reusable logic and documented outputs.
impact: Demonstrates end-to-end SQL thinking: translating business questions into reliable analysis and decision-ready findings.

title: Adventure Works Sales & Customer Insights Report
description: An interactive Power BI analysis of Adventure Works sales, profit, returns, products, pricing, and customer behavior.
challenge: Create one executive view that connects commercial performance with product, customer, pricing, and returns behavior.
approach: Built a semantic model with executive KPIs, trend analysis, what-if scenarios, drill-through pages, and natural-language Q&A.
impact: Enables leaders to move from a headline KPI to its customer, product, and regional drivers without leaving the report.

title: Al Amreyah Cement Budget Analysis Report
description: An interactive financial diagnosis covering revenue, expenses, profitability, budget variance, liquidity, and working capital.
challenge: Bring budget, actuals, balance-sheet position, and profitability into one coherent management view.
approach: Modeled financial statements and variance logic, then designed drillable views for period, location, level, and budget type.
impact: Surfaces performance gaps and liquidity pressure quickly enough to support management action.

title: A/B Testing and SQL Analysis with Python
description: A reproducible A/B testing workflow combining data cleaning, SQL, and statistical testing to compare CTR performance between test and control groups.
challenge: Determine whether an observed click-through-rate difference is a real treatment effect or normal variation.
approach: Validated experiment data, queried the analytical sample, defined hypotheses, and tested the difference with transparent statistical logic.
impact: Turns experiment results into an evidence-based decision instead of relying on a surface-level percentage comparison.

title: Breadfast Automated Discount Monitoring Dashboard
description: An interactive report monitoring automated discounts, OOV inventory, discounted sales, and waste-reduction performance.
challenge: Evaluate whether automated discounting reduces waste without creating excessive discount spend or availability risk.
approach: Connected discount, sales, waste, and out-of-stock indicators into an exception-led monitoring experience.
impact: Creates a single operating view for balancing commercial return, availability, and waste reduction.

title: Medical Appointment No Show Dataset Analysis
description: An exploratory analysis of more than 100,000 medical appointments in Brazil focused on patterns behind missed visits.
challenge: Identify the patient, scheduling, and communication factors associated with appointment no-shows.
approach: Cleaned the data, profiled attendance patterns, compared segments, and visualized the strongest behavioral signals.
impact: Provides an analytical foundation for reminder, scheduling, and patient-engagement interventions.

title: Covid-19 Dashboard - Personal Project
description: A global Covid-19 monitoring report covering confirmed cases, recoveries, geographic concentration, and comparative trends.
challenge: Make a fast-changing global dataset understandable across countries and headline indicators.
approach: Imported web data, cleaned it in Power Query, and designed an interactive geographic and KPI-led report.
impact: Supports quick comparison of pandemic scale and recovery patterns across geographies.
